description.intro: The Nike Barcelona children's Dri-Fit Strike training tracksuit is designed for young footballers to train comfortably while representing FC Barcelona. It incorporates details inspired by the garments used by the football elite and a construction prepared to accompany each movement. Made of 100% polyester, this set combines functionality, comfort and the Barça identity to enjoy every football session.
key_benefits: Comfort for training: Designed to accompany young soccer players during their soccer sessions.
Sweat management: Helps maintain a cooler and more comfortable feeling during activity.
Design for football: Its details are designed for the needs of promising young players on the pitch.
Nike Strike Look: Aesthetics inspired by the training garments used by the soccer elite.
Complete set: A practical option to train and represent FC Barcelona.
